title: Mixing: 1882 by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Paul McCartney was considering releasing a live recording of ‘1882’ on Wings’ second album. 10 November 1972 was the second of four consecutive days of mixing live recordings of the song from the Wings Over Europe Tour.

The final five dates of the tour had been recorded by the Rolling Stones Mobile Studio:

  • 19 August: Wings live: Martinihal, Groningen
  • 20 August: Wings live: Concertgebouw, Amsterdam
  • 21 August: Wings live: Congresgebouw, The Hague
  • 22 August: Wings live: Kinema Roma, Antwerp
  • 24 August: Wings live: Deutschlandhalle, Berlin

McCartney oversaw stereo mixes of all five performances of ‘1882’, but eventually decided to record a studio version on 13 November.

Page last updated: 26 November 2025
